observations: Tall, slightly low-angle medium-full shot with a large empty wall above her for the balloon. Ananya stands at frame right beside a blue door frame, in a three-quarter view turned toward frame left.

She matches the sheet: low bun, gold stud, teal kurta under the open white coat, stethoscope around her neck, dark leggings, flat sandals. Level brows and calm, slightly heavy-lidded eyes. Her expression is a thoughtful, closed-mouth half-smile that reads as quiet resolve.

Hands match production: her right hand (screen-left) is curled with the fingertips at her chin; her left hand (screen-right) is loosely closed at the front of the coat. Both hands are anatomically clean.

Background at frame left: Meera at the desk. Left hand holds the receiver to her left ear (cord to the beige phone), right hand with the bangle writes in an open register. Braid on her left shoulder, blue print kurta. Her eyeline and Ananya's gaze connect across the panel. The stacked registers match 01-2.

Two standing women (grey-haired in a rose sari, and a younger woman) appear just behind Meera's shoulder. Their depth relative to the desk is slightly ambiguous, but they read as queue patients and do not interfere. The grey-haired woman's sari is rose/maroon, not the lilac of 01-1, so she reads as a different patient. Acceptable.
No text appears on the walls, registers or window. The blue padded waiting chairs match the new 03-1 reception.
